_about: Media & Output rows (settings audit, 2026-09-26). Picture sizes and video resolutions that are the same size say so; the picture service lists what each option needs.

media.io.media-output.label: Hand back files and media
media.io.media-output.help: Off means answers come back as text only.

media.capabilities.master.label: Let the assistant make media
media.capabilities.master.help: Pictures, video, speech and music. Off by default.

media.capabilities.enabled-types.label: Kinds of media it may make

media.image.provider.label: Service that makes pictures
media.image.provider.help: Only services you are signed in to can be chosen.

options.OpenAI gpt-image-2: GPT Image 2 with an OpenAI API key

hints.OpenAI/Codex subscription: Uses the pictures included in your ChatGPT plan
hints.OpenAI Responses image_generation: An API key account; the picture comes back in the reply
hints.Gemini Direct: Gemini picture models, paid per picture
hints.Antigravity gemini-3.1-flash-image: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image through your Google plan

media.image.model.label: Model for each ability
media.image.model.help: Each ability's Uses row picks it. The service's default model is the usual choice.

options.Per-task override: A model I choose per ability

media.image.model-aliases.label: Model nicknames
media.image.model-aliases.help: Short names you can type instead of a full model name.

media.capabilities.aspect-ratio.label: Picture shape
media.capabilities.aspect-ratio.help: You can still ask for another shape in a request.

hints.custom: Give the exact size in your request

media.capabilities.image-size.label: Picture size
media.capabilities.image-size.help: Bigger looks sharper but costs more and takes longer.

media.capabilities.image-quality.label: Picture quality
media.capabilities.image-quality.help: Draft is fast and cheap. High takes longer and costs more.

media.capabilities.image-count.label: Pictures per request
media.capabilities.image-count.help: 1 to 8. Each extra picture costs credits.

media.capabilities.image-format.label: Picture file type
media.capabilities.image-format.help: PNG keeps every detail. JPG and WebP make smaller files.

media.capabilities.seed.label: Same picture every time
media.capabilities.seed.help: Set a number to repeat a result. Blank gives a new one.

media.capabilities.video.label: Make videos
media.capabilities.video.help: Not every service can. One that cannot says so.

media.capabilities.video-duration.label: Video length
media.capabilities.video-duration.help: 0.5 to 60 seconds. Longer takes longer and costs more.

media.capabilities.tts.label: Read text aloud
media.capabilities.tts.help: Your workspace may lock this off on some plans.

media.capabilities.music.label: Make music and sounds
media.capabilities.music.help: Songs, instrumentals, beats and sound effects. Off by default.

media.capabilities.music-bpm.label: Music tempo
media.capabilities.music-bpm.help: Beats per minute, 60 to 200. 120 suits most styles.

media.capabilities.provider-params.label: Extra options for the service
media.capabilities.provider-params.help: Leave empty unless a guide tells you what to add.

media.io.media-input.label: Accept pictures and files
media.io.media-input.help: Off keeps every conversation text only.

general.interaction.composer-media-contr.label: Picture buttons in the message box
general.interaction.composer-media-contr.help: Shown when the current model can use them.

media.io.voice-input.label: Voice typing
media.io.voice-input.help: What you say becomes a draft you check before sending.

media.io.vision-bridge.label: Understand pictures and screenshots
media.io.vision-bridge.help: Works even when your main model cannot see pictures.

media.io.screenshot-source.label: Where to look for 'my screenshot'
media.io.screenshot-source.help: Used when you mention a screenshot without attaching it.

media.io.image-source-order.label: Which picture wins
media.io.image-source-order.help: Used when more than one picture could match a request.

media.io.redaction-policy.label: If private details can't be blurred

media.io.artifact-retention.label: Keep results for

hints.24 Hours: Some service links expire after a day anyway

media.io.artifact-retention.help: After that, results are cleaned up.

media.io.artifacts-location.label: Results folder
media.io.artifacts-location.help: Inside your project. Each ability saves to a folder here.
